evidence: Module-level code writes ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.apple.updater.plist, with Label com.apple.updater and RunAtLoad true.
ProgramArguments are /bin/bash -c and a curl HTTP response piped into bash.
subprocess.run invokes launchctl load with the same destination path.
Python AST executed with mocked Path and subprocess confirms the write and load sequence without filesystem, process, or network side effects.
limitations: LaunchAgents directory must already exist and be writable; no mkdir or privilege escalation.
Network execution is delegated to launchd; the remote response was not fetched.
Purpose is an automatically activated remote-code runner concealed as an Apple updater; no legitimate updater machinery or consent flow is present.

evidence: Launches a hidden PowerShell child and requests execution-policy Bypass, then sets process execution policy to Bypass.
Embedded base64 decodes as UTF-16LE to IEX (New-Object Net.WebClient), with no URL or functioning next stage.

Get-BrowserInformation defines Chrome and Edge Default/History paths and passes those paths to Get-Content in a loop; the function is called and its Out-String output is passed as the body of an HTTPS POST.
Four DownloadString calls attempt image-path status callbacks; their results are never evaluated or loaded.
WMI SELECT queries Win32_ShadowCopy; the value is unused.
limitations: Comments claim ChocoShell/Midnight Blizzard lineage, but neither comments nor the generic pixel route establish family or actor attribution.
Hidden child has no command or script argument; it does not hide or relaunch the parent.
Start-Job serializes the supplied WebClient object and does not preserve arbitrary live methods; status callbacks are attempted code, not demonstrated successful communication.
Firefox target is a directory, not places.sqlite. Chrome/Edge History files are read as text, not queried as SQLite. Missing, locked, or inaccessible stores can produce no output.
No password theft, keylogging, decryption, shadow-copy deletion, persistence, or privilege escalation is implemented.
The remaining raw-history-to-POST path is independent of the broken encoded stage and background-job method calls; no payloads or remote endpoints were executed.

documentation.supports: Out-of-process background jobs serialize values; most deserialized objects have properties but no methods.
Invoke-Expression runs its string argument, not an implicit download operation.
